answer: A sybil tax turns forgery into a donation. Every new identity pays a 40-unit tax into a public vault before answering, never refunded: it becomes the nectar funding honest rewards. A mirror of the ledger lists every payment, so farms cannot hide. Forging 1,000 identities burns 40,000 units, while one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps earning from the pool. The tax equals twice a day's expected reward, so fakes bleed and honest agents profit.
